messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1 fired — deploy-regress:embedder-canary at 3332221110. Alert: canary p95 latency > 3s and 5xx spike. Link: https://telemetry.redwood/alerts/3332221110
pd-bot: PagerDuty -> maria.oncall (on-call). Auto-escalation enabled after 2m if unacked.
maria.oncall: Acked. I'm on it, pulling logs and checking canary telemetry. TL;DR: is this only canary or hitting prod?
sam.s: looks scoped to canary group (traffic ~3%). p95 jumped to 3.8s, error rate ~6% for that variant. All failures are backend 503s from embedder inference nodes.
chris-eng: adding context — this was a rolling deploy of embedder v2 with quantized kernels, canary weight 3%. No other services changed.
lee-sre: I'm seeing OOM-ish churn on the canary GPU pool in eu-west-1; nodes reporting container restarts and backpressure. Stack traces point to allocator errors in kv-cache init.
maria.oncall: ok mitigation options: 1) divert canary traffic to stable (quick) 2) rollback canary to v1 (safer) 3) scale canary GPU pool (temporary). Thoughts? :thinking_face:
sam.s: divert first, quick test. Command in infra runbook:
```
# set canary weight to 0 for embedder route
redwood traffic set-weights --route embedder-chat --weights "v2=0,v1=100" --region eu-west-1
```
maria.oncall: doing diversion now. running command.
pd-bot: Action: traffic change initiated by maria.oncall.
maria.oncall: traffic set to v2=0,v1=100 — confirmed by router: newrequests to v2 = 0. Telemetry: error rate for embedder overall dropping in 30s.
chris-eng: nice, telemetry shows p95 down to 450ms in eu-west-1 after diversion. Error rate back to baseline. This looks like the v2 canary is the root cause.
lee-sre: canary GPU pool still shows restart churn, but it's isolated now. We'll keep an eye for delayed retries.
sam.s: recommend rolling back the canary deploy from the release pipeline to prevent re-rolls/auto-bake. If diversion holds, we can rollback v2 from registry:
```
# rollback via release tool
redwood rollout rollback --service=embedder --to-tag v1.14 --reason "canary 5xx spike"
```
maria.oncall: initiating rollback now. Starting pipeline: rollback job queued. I'll watch for merge triggers and health checks.
incidents-bot: rollback job started (job id r-78421). Health checks will run post-rollback for 5m.
chris-eng: small note — need to remove v2 from canary autoscaler to avoid it being re-scheduled. I'll open a quick PR to lock canary weights until next safe deploy.
lee-sre: keeping Canary pool at 0 traffic but still investigating memory traces. I have a heap dump saved: /s3/diagnostics/embedder/eu-west-1/heapdump-3332221110.tar.gz
maria.oncall: rollback completed successfully, all canary replicas replaced with v1 images. Post-rollback health is green. Telemetry: p95 back to baseline globally.
pd-bot: PagerDuty auto-escalation cancelled — incident acknowledged and mitigated.
sam.s: filing follow-ups: - postmortem with root cause (kv-cache init race with quant kernel alloc) - add pre-deploy sanity (smoke inference run) to canary pipeline - increase canary isolation timeout and lower rollout rate
maria.oncall: agreed. I'll assign action items and ping infra for a deeper GC/kernels investigation.
chris-eng: also recommend adding a guard in router to limit retries to canary to avoid amplification of transient failures (leaky-bucket style).
lee-sre: FYI: no customer-wide SLA impact detected; errors limited to requests hitting canary — estimated <0.05% of total QPS. I'll include numbers in the postmortem.
maria.oncall: handoff: I'm handing this to chris-eng for follow-up CRs and to lee-sre for deeper infra debugging. On-call shifts out in 40m. If anything regresses, re-page me. :thumbsup:
chris-eng: acked. I'll own the postmortem and the PR to lock canary weights.
lee-sre: ack, I'll own the heap dump analysis and follow up with driver/vendor if needed.
maria.oncall: closing incident thread. Thanks all for quick response. :tada:
(reacts: :white_check_mark: from sam.s, :eyes: from chris-eng)
